pages.text: The $(l)Crimson Bunny$() is an agile combat toy inspired by Arlecchino. Moving exclusively through forward leaps, she dominates the battlefield with precision and lethal burst potential.

pages.title: Unit Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 40$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 15$(li)$(6)Damage:$() 6.5$(br2)Behaves like a rabbit, moving strictly by $(b)jumping forward$().

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(li)$(4)Lethal Charge:$() When fully charged, her next strike deals $(4)double damage$() and briefly $(4)stuns$() the target.$(br2) Devastating when allowed to reach full potency.
Crafted with blood-red alloys and agile mechanics.
